title: Protect and remotely back up existing local in-flight P0-D work
goal: Review and back up only the existing dirty P0-D source work to a safe integration branch. Handoff artifacts are already remote. Never push/force main.
implementation_steps: Recheck work HEAD/status and protected DB sha256 against freeze anchors
Review app_evidence.py diff and the three untracked artifacts for scope/secrets/temp/DB files
Push only safe integration backup branch, non-force, never main

minimal_test_commands.Level_D_phase_regression: Only if required by current scoped changes
minimal_test_commands.Level_E_full_suite_GATE_ONLY: Do not run full suite merely for backup unless a gate requires it

expected_after: In-flight P0-D work is safely present on a remote integration backup branch; main and real DB remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Safe remote integration backup exists; no secret/DB/temp artifact included; no main/force write.
failure_conditions: Freeze mismatch, secret/DB/temp detection, unexpected scope expansion, or any main/force requirement → stop and report exact evidence.
db_guard: No DB mutation; protected DB sha256 must remain unchanged.
